content: Hen natéyan Lazaro

Angkay ad Betania, wachacha hen toroy masosnod way cha Maria an Marta ya ah Lazaro. Ah Mariaanchi, hiya hen anchi nanginhiyat hen lana hen he-en Jesus yag emponahna hen fuùna. Yachi yag nansaket ah Lazaro
wat imfilin cha Maria an Marta ah Jesus way mangaliyén, “Apo, chan saket ah Lazaro way ifam way laylaychém.”
Angkay chengngar Jesuschi yag ekatnéén, “Faén matéy hen kahalenonotan hen anchi saket Lazaro, te an kachayawan Apudyus way yachi agé hen machayawà way anàna.”
Ah Jesus, laylaychéna tot-owa chicha amin way masosnod,
ngém hen nangngarana hen nansaketan Lazaro, iggay chillu lumigwat hen hiyachi te egad nanlooh hen chuway ag-agaw
yag annaat ifaga hen anchichay pasorotna way mangaliyén, “Intaaw ta kasentaaw éméy hen sakopon Judea.”
“Oo Apo,” way chacha ekat, “ngém tég-angay cha-a funto-on hen anchichay Judio ahchi ad chin-argaw wat ay ammoh kasentaaw agé éméy.”

Yachi, yag nampani ah Jesus agé way mangaliyén, “Hemporo ya chuway uras hen umi-innitan hen init hen ihay ag-agaw, wat no manaran hen tatagu hen ag-agaw, achi mehagaw te hehellawan hen init hen charanéna.
Ngém no lafi hen manaranana, kapeletan way mehagaw te helang.”
Enalen Jesuschi yag annaat ekat agéén, “Nanasséy hen anchi ifataaw way Lazaro, wat intaaw ta iyà fangonon hiya.”
Yag sommongfat hen anchichay pasorotna way mangaliyén, “Oo a Apo, ngém no an nasséy, kapeletan way cha umun-unnina hen saketna.”
Ngém hen laychén peet Jesus way aryénat, an peet nanattéy ah Lazaro, yag hen na-awatanchaat an nasséy.
Yachi yag anat lawrawagén Jesus way mangaliyén, “An natéy ah Lazaro,
ngém ah pagsaya-atanyu, ammay te maichà hen natéyana ta wachay mangafurotanyu an haén. Wat intaaw ta intaaw ilan hiya.”
Yachi yag nan-ale hen ihay ifacha way ah Tomas way kapel, yag ekatnan chichéén, “Antaaw ammag màyéy amin an Apotaaw ta no pédténcha, yag nìyatéytaaw kagé amin an hiya.”
Ah Jesus hen anchi managu hen tatagu ya hen mempauchi hen natéy
Angkay hiyachi way inumchah cha Jesus ad Betania, chengngarcha way looh nilurufù ah Lazaro hen opatay ag-agaw.
Yag gapo ta an yanggay toroy lometor ménat hen ka-achawwéy Betania ad Jerusalem,
wat chuarcha hen anchichay iJerusalem way émméy way i mangay-ayu an cha Marta an Maria gapon natéyan hen sonodcha.
Angkay hiyachi way chengngar Marta way naway cha Jesus, ina hinib-at chicha. Waman ah Maria, iggay gumhad.
Angkay inumchah ah Marta an cha Jesus yag ekatnéén, “Apo, non an-a koma wacha wat iggay matéy hen sonodtaaw.
Ngém innilà chillu way uray ad uwan, wat heno way ifagam an Apudyusat idchatna an hea.”
Yachi yag ekat Jesus an hiyéén, “Man-uchi hen annay sonodno.”
“Oo, innilà way man-uchi,” way ekat Marta, “te afurotò way man-uchicha chillu hen aminay natéy ah pegwana.”
Yag anat ekat Jesus agéén, “Haén hen mangempauchi hen tatagu te haén hen managu an chicha. Wat heno way mangafurot an haén, tàén matéyat taguwê hiya chillu.
Ya heno way natattagu, no omafurot an haén, achi matéy ah ing-inggana. Ay afurotomto.”
“Oo Apo, afurotòha,” way ekat Marta, “ya afurotò agé way hea hen Cristu way anà Apudyus way empopostana way umale hen antoy lota.”
Hen nankelaan Jesus
Angkay hiyachi way enalen Martachi, yag ommanamot ah faréycha way i nanget-én an Maria way mangaliyén, “Inumchah ah Apotaaw yag chana imohon hea.”
Hen nangngaran Mariahchi, enag-aggagna way ginumhad way i manib-at an Jesus,
te cha Jesus, cha-ancha homàyat ah fabréy, te é-éttégcha hen anchi nanaynanan Marta an chicha.
Yachi yag hen anchichay tatagu way inu-umfun ah faréy, innilacha hen ginumhachan Maria wat ummunudcha, te ekatcha ah hamhamàchéén an ménat éméy ah lufù way i mankela.
Angkay inumchah ah Maria hen anchi iggawcha, ammag nampalentomang hen henagong Jesus way mangaliyén, “Apo cha-an angkay matéy hen anchi sonodtaaw non an-a wachahto.”
Yachi way innilan Jesus hen chana mankelaan ya hen anchichay netnod way tatagu way ahekekela agé, yag naség-angan way térén yag ammag ommaghéy ah hamhamàna,
yag annaat ekatén, “Chuud hen nanginlufuanyu an hiya.” Yag ekatchéén, “Ahchi Apo, wat intaaw ta intaaw ilan.”
Yachi yag nankela agéh Jesus.
Wat ekat hen anchichay tataguwén, “Ammag amchan tot-owa hen hamhamàna an Lazaro.”
Ngém ekat agé hen tapenéén, “Oo a, ngém no makaka-an hen finurag hen tatagu, wat pakay emparufusna hen natéyan hen annay ifana nò.”
Hen nan-uchiyan Lazaro
Angkay hiyachi way chengngar Jesus hen anchi enalecha, ammag kaskasen way nahéphép hen hamhamàna. Yag hiyachi way inumchahcha hen anchi lufù way liyang way natangfan ah tépà,
yag anat ifagan Jesus way mangaliyén, “Ka-anényu hen annay tangéb hen lufù.” Ngém ommamhew ah Marta way mangaliyén, “Apo, man-agub angkay ad uwan te apatna way ag-agaw hen natéyana.”
Yag ekat agé Jesus an hiyéén, “Oo a, ngém imfafaggà met an hea way no afurotona-at ilam hen machayawan Apudyus.”
Yachi yag kena-ancha hen anchi tangébna yag nantangad ah Jesus way mangaliyén, “Ama, manyamanà an hea te cham changrén haén.
Inni-ilà chillu way chachangrénà, ngém aryêto ah mangngaran hen antochay tatagu ta afurotoncha koma agé way hea hen nannag an haén.”
Yachi way enalen Jesuschi, yag annaat chakarén way mangaliyén, “Lazaro, fùnag-a.”

Yag ammag fummùnagat agé hen anchi natéy way napopottepotan hen limana ingganah he-ena way naoppeopan amin hen uruna. Yag anat ekat Jesus hen anchichay tataguwén, “Ùfachényu ta wachay én-énnéna way omanamot.”
Hen nantetennopa-ancha ah mamchitancha an Jesus
Angkay hen anchichay Judio way i nì-ib-ifun an Maria, chuar an chicha hen ommafurot an Jesus hen nangil-ancha hen anchi enammaana.
Ngém wachacha chillu hen tapena way i nanaphapet hen anchichay Fariseo hen anchi enammaana.

Yag hen anchichay Fariseo ya hen anap-apon hen papachi, empa-ayagcha hen anchichay toray way konsel, yag nan-a-atopàpàcha way mangaliyén, “Nokay lawa hen én-énnéntaaw hen ihay taguwanna way ammag lonay hen chana ammaan way kaskascha-aw.

Te no antaaw ammag igiginnang ta chana payépayéén, ah awni yag hiyaat agé hen somorotan hen katagutagu. Yag no hiyachi hen mekaman, omaningarngarcha hen anchichay toray ad Roma wat awni yag anchag chachaelén hen anchi Templotaaw yag kena-ancha agé hen aminay mantorayantaaw.”
Yachi yag nan-ale hen iha an chicha way ah Caifas hen ngachanna way hiya hen anchi kangatowan way pachi hen hiyachiy tawén, ekatnéén, “Aẁ ay ammoh ammag maid pèot chi hamhamàyu,
te ay ammoh achiyu peet elasin way un-unnina hen ihà-an ah matéy ah sobfot hen kachuaran no hen machachaelantaaw amin way Judio.”
Hen hiyachiy enalen Caifas, faén ah hamhamàna hen narpowana te gapo ta hiya hen kangatowanay pachi wat an empahmà Apudyus an hiya way masapor matéy ah Jesus ah sokat hen aminay Judio.
Ya faén agé yanggay hen anchichay Judio hen masobfot hen matéyan Jesus, te aminay tatagu way niwaras hen antoy lota way anaén Apudyusat masobfotcha ah kateponancha amin.
Nanepod hen hiyachi, inlugin hen anchichay anap-apon hen Judio way mantatagépfar ah ekamancha way mamchit an Jesus.
Wat yachi, ammag maid én-énnén Jesus way manggégga-ay hen kawad-an hen chuaray Judio, wat inyapetna ad Efraim way fabréy way nehag-én hen anchi chanak, wat ahchi hen ini-inggawancha.

Angkay hiyachi way tég-angay umchah hen anchi lagsak hen Judio way Manmanma-an, wat chacha ma-amoamong ad Jerusalem hen chuaray tatagu way narpoh kafabréfabréy, ta incha mampacharos ah Templo ya anchaat mèlagsak.
Yachi way nahibhib-atcha ah Templo chacha langrangéén ah Jesus way manganap ya chachan ahepennoot way mangaliyén, “Nokay ngata hen manmanmàyu, ay umale ngén ah Jesus way i mèlagsak ono achi.”
Hen anchichay Fariseo ya anap-apon hen papachi, imfilincha hen anchichay tatagu ta no wacha hen mangila an Jesus, masapor ifagacha ta mepatelew.
